verdict.rationale: Basecamp documents MCP support, a CLI and skills for external AI agents, and card tables for bug tracking. None of this shows a Basecamp capability that automatically triages or prioritizes incoming bugs or tasks. These are building blocks an agent could use to build triage, not the triage feature itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI automatically triage and prioritize incoming bugs and tasks
